title: automorphic-strong-approximation widget params
description: Bespoke strong-approximation factorisation stepper for the automorphic-forms-adelic topic. Three buttons step through writing an adelic GL_2 element as a product of a rational matrix, an archimedean factor, and an open-compact subgroup factor; an SVG visualises the decomposition. The button-trio plus diagram-of-double-cosets layout is specific to strong approximation and does not fit a shared button-stepper slug.
